review_scope: Independent plain-source/text/hash/read-only Git review only. No source parser/import, helper, compiler/formatter/validator/program, provider/test/network execution. No live native/software workspace or output read; only this sidecar written.

exact_scope_and_provenance.only_changed_region: Stage evaluation region between original dx/du zero initialization and first Real sixth final-sum statement in IntegrateGeodesicRK4CartDelta.

stage_induction.invariant: Before stage j>0, previousDx/previousDu are exactly the immediately preceding original dt-scaled stage increments; every completed named pair equals its corresponding original expression. Out dx/du stay at original zero initialization until all4 RHS evaluations succeed.

inputs.state: Exact state copy; no add-zero or multiply-one arithmetic.
Original state + 0.5f times original dt-scaled dx1/du1.
Original state + 0.5f times original dt-scaled dx2/du2.
Original state + original dx3/du3; no multiply-one.

stage_induction.operation_order: At each stage, unchanged fallible acceleration first, then Scale(stageState.u,dt), then Scale(acceleration,dt), then plain assignments to that stage pair. No dt/2 rewrite, coefficient table, reassociation or new rounding conversion.

stage_induction.state_values: GeodesicStateCart contains exactly x/u Vec4Cart value fields; stage copy/reset introduces no arithmetic or mutable resource alias.

refusal_and_commit_contract.stage_refusal: Failure at stage j executes j+1 original RHS evaluations and immediately returns false with out dx/du still their original zeros; no later stage or endpoint predicate.
refusal_and_commit_contract.endpoint_refusal: After four successes, original weighted grouping and Real(1)/Real(6) compute out dx/du before the unchanged endpoint predicate. A false endpoint leaves those computed deltas, as original; they are not newly zeroed.
refusal_and_commit_contract.public_wrapper: IntegrateGeodesicRK4Cart initializes result=state, uses distinct dx/du locals, and commits x/u only on true.
refusal_and_commit_contract.composite: Existing coarse/fine passes reset independently to original state; a coarse-stage refusal resets only its pass and does not suppress independent fine execution.
refusal_and_commit_contract.common_policy_tail: Representability failure, error estimate, null/projector checks, controller factor/exponent, floor selection, tolerances and downstream caller rollback/counters remain byte-exact.
refusal_and_commit_contract.no_new_input_domain_restriction: Original dt/family parameters and fallible metric authority retained; no precomputed half-dt scaling changes representability/underflow/overflow order.
